name: COMAddIns
description: A collection of COMAddIn objects that provide information about a COM add-in registered in the Windows registry.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the COMAddIns object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return that object's container application). Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the COMAddIns object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Gets a count of the number of COM add-ins in the host application. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the COMAddIns object. Read-only.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Gets a member of the specified COMAddIns collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: Represents the location of the member within the collection.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the contents of the COMAddIns collection from the list of add-ins stored in the Windows registry.
